items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: on that date there was Tony and Alice Stratigas, I believe, on trombone... And myself, just five pieces, I believe.

ctx.x: Yeah. One was called In the Dungeon and the other was when you and I were pals. And on that date there was Tony and Alice Stratigas, I believe, on trombone.
That reminds me, you're on a record he made on Vocalion, is that right? Stratigas?
